invariants.rationale: context is required to represent the engine context for write operations.
instantTime typically represents a required commit instant or timestamp, which should be non-null and non-empty.
records should be non-null since they encapsulate the data to be written.
bulkInsertPartitioner, an Option type, must at least be non-null; its internal value can be absent.
If records is not empty, it has a positive size (property of List collections).
